description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the RetrieveAttributes class, including tests for immutability, equality, exception cases, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the RetrieveAttributes class, focusing on immutability, equality, exception handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that RetrieveAttributes instances are immutable and that JsonFieldSelector and ThingId are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for RetrieveAttributes.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveAttributes with a null string ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveAttributes with a null ThingId instance throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Tests creation of RetrieveAttributes with valid arguments.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson() method returns the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating RetrieveAttributes from a JSON string and verifies correct deserialization.
